reason: GCC rejects the MVE vector assignments this header relies on; Arm Compiler reinterprets them implicitly. The patch adds an explicit cast to the declared type on each failing assignment and changes nothing else. Only bit-reversal index arithmetic is touched, not floating-point work.
notice: Lines 24-34 are the Apache-2.0 section 4(b) modification notice. The measured firmware compiled this file before the notice was added (patched_sha256_without_notice); every code line is identical.
